name: Lightning Shield
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level: alchemist 4, magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 4, storm knight 4, witch 4

Components: V, S, M (a piece of material from an area struck by lightning)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Personal

Target(s): You

Duration: 1 round/level (D)

This spell is identical to fire shield but produces and protects against lightning, instead of fire and the damage it deals is electrical (shock).
